summary: Senior Credit Investments, LLC filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing that on September 29, 2026 its board declared a cash distribution of $15.7021 per common limited liability company unit. The distribution is payable October 20, 2026 to unitholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. The company is a Delaware LLC with no listed securities. This is a capital return event, not a special situation. Watch for repeat distributions and any future liquidity or valuation events given the illiquid, non-traded structure.
